I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard, Dock Doors 14–18, weren't getting their SMS bay assignments on the 04:00 shift. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning that it was fixed.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 for firmware testing. The note has no date, and I didn't see anything saying it was closed.

Two things to watch for:
- The ticket numbers that look similar in Moss's Central handoff digest (#4409, #4412, FR-882) belong to Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon.
- Quarendon Freightways (one "r") is a different company and isn't a customer, so don't mix the two up in the deck.

I only searched what you can open yourself: the shared Moss digests, your channels and this DM. I didn't search any of Moss's notes that aren't shared, or the Quarrendon incident channel, because you're not in it. The North team (Dana Okafor or Ilse Varga) would have the full ticket list for the deck.
